key_findings.finding: card1=9633 carries a heavy mature fraud history: prior fraud rate 16.69% at card1 level and 24.29% for card1+email, vs ~3.5% base rate — 4.8x–6.9x elevated.
Extreme fan-out on card1=9633 (372 devices, 28 addr1, 17 emails) with gang_score=1.0 indicates a coordinated ring / mule pattern.
Two entity-fraud-history rules fire strongly: card1+email prior fraud (19.11%, 5.4x lift) and card1 prior fraud (17.32%, 4.9x lift).
This txn nearly matches confirmed-fraud case #3456924 (same card1=9633, ProductCD=C, visa/debit, gmail, Samsung SM device, similar ~$55–81 amount).

The three washed-out false-positive cases on this card1 are distinguishable: they had missing/different devices AND low model scores (0.41–0.59); this txn presents a concrete device fingerprint (SM-G920P) aligning with the confirmed-fraud case, not the FP cluster.
The upstream GBDT score p=0.9957 is corroborated (not contradicted) by independent entity-history and case evidence; ProductCD=C also carries elevated fraud (11.39%, 3.3x).

gang_association.rationale: card1=9633 shows gang_score=1.0, massive device fan-out (372 devices across 17 emails / 28 addresses), high mature fraud rate, and a near-identical confirmed-fraud case — consistent with a coordinated fraud ring using this card1 across many devices.

report.disposition_rationale: Strong gang evidence (entity fraud history 16.7%–24.3%, fan-out 372 devices, gang_score=1.0) plus a matching confirmed-fraud case. Although the amount is small ($81.34), freezing/building a case on card1=9633 stops future batch fraud, which is worth the $40 escalation cost. The distinguishable false-positive cluster (missing devices, low scores) does not exonerate this txn.
report.summary: Transaction 3528434 ($81.34, ProductCD=C, visa/debit, gmail, mobile SM-G920P) rides on card1=9633, which shows overwhelming ring signals: gang_score=1.0, fan-out to 372 devices/17 emails/28 addresses, and mature fraud rates of 16.7% (card1) to 24.3% (card1+email). Two entity-fraud rules fire at ~5x lift, and the txn nearly matches confirmed-fraud case #3456924. The three washed-out false positives on this card1 are separable — they had missing devices and low model scores, whereas this txn carries a concrete device fingerprint matching the confirmed-fraud pattern. The GBDT p=0.9957 is thus independently corroborated. Given the gang evidence, escalate to freeze the entity and block batch fraud despite the small amount.
